items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Outside of Franky Deuce was an off-cousin of mine.

ctx.x: Can you tell us anything about your family, if anyone else in your family, that is your father or any uncles or brothers or any older brothers? Anybody else that played music before you? No. No. None of them.
Outside of Franky Deuce was an off-cousin of mine. He's in his- He was a cousin, Franky Deuce.

Franky Deuce, yeah. What was your first instrument? Did you start on drums? Started on drums, yeah. Started on drums. How come you liked- Did you like drums when you were a boy? What age were you when you started?
